    toc-depth: 2

params:
  committee_code: "5185"
  committee_name: ""        # optional display name; auto-populated by render.R
---

```{r}
library(duckdb)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(htmltools)

source(here("R/ui_helpers.R"))
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), here("data/campaign_finance/campaign_finance.duckdb"), read_only = TRUE)

# Committee codes are a mix of numeric ("5185") and alphanumeric ("CTY51589",
# "SWGA51409") strings. A numeric-looking code passed via `-P` arrives as a
# number, which makes DuckDB cast the whole varchar column to INT32 and fail on
# the alphanumeric rows. Coerce once so the query always compares strings.
committee_code_param <- as.character(params$committee_code)

comm_meta <- tbl(con, "committees") |>
  filter(committee_code == committee_code_param) |>
  collect()

comm_stats <- tbl(con, "committee_summary") |>
  filter(committee_code == committee_code_param) |>
  collect()

by_year <- tbl(con, "committee_year") |>
  filter(committee_code == committee_code_param) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type))

by_donor <- tbl(con, "committee_donor") |>
  filter(committee_code == committee_code_param) |>
  collect()

all_contributions <- tbl(con, "contributions") |>
  filter(committee_code == committee_code_param) |>
  select(date, donor_display, donor_type, clean_city, norm_state,
         contribution_amount, transaction_type) |>
  arrange(desc(date)) |>
  collect()

all_expenditures <- tbl(con, "expenditures") |>
  filter(committee_code == committee_code_param) |>
  select(date, year, expenditure_amount, transaction_type,
         recipient_display, city, state) |>
  collect()

dbDisconnect(con)

has_meta          <- nrow(comm_meta) > 0
has_contributions <- nrow(comm_stats) > 0
has_expenditures  <- nrow(all_expenditures) > 0

display_name <- if (nchar(params$committee_name) > 0) {
  params$committee_name
} else if (has_contributions) {
  comm_stats$committee_name[1]
} else if (has_meta) {
  comm_meta$committee_name[1]
} else {
  params$committee_code
}
```

```{r}
# Committee header card: eyebrow (committee type), serif name, meta row.
# Party is a text label rather than a color — money is deliberately shown in
# the neutral palette so the page doesn't read as taking a side.
ci <- if (has_contributions) comm_stats[1, ] else NULL
mi <- if (has_meta) comm_meta[1, ] else NULL
src <- if (!is.null(ci)) ci else mi

field <- function(label, val) {
  if (is.null(val) || length(val) == 0) return(NULL)
  txt <- str_squish(as.character(val))
  # NA, "", whitespace, and the literal "NA" that survives some IECDB exports
  if (is.na(txt) || !nzchar(txt) || txt == "NA") return(NULL)
  span(strong(label), HTML("&nbsp;"), txt)
}

eyebrow_txt <- if (!is.null(src) && !is.na(src$committee_type)) {
  toupper(src$committee_type)
} else {
  "IOWA COMMITTEE"
}

# Statewide offices carry district "0" in the registry; that's a placeholder,
# not a district, so it stays off the page.
district_txt <- if (is.null(src$district)) NA else {
  d <- str_squish(as.character(src$district))
  if (!is.na(d) && nzchar(d) && d != "0") d else NA
}

meta_row <- if (!is.null(src)) {
  tagList(
    field("Candidate", src$candidate_name),
    field("Party", src$party),
    field("Office", src$office_sought),
    field("District", district_txt),
    field("County", if (!is.null(mi)) mi$county else NA),
    field("Code", committee_code_param)
  )
} else {
  tagList(
    span("Committee not found in the Iowa IECDB registry."),
    field("Code", committee_code_param)
  )
}

div(class = "ia-card",
  div(class = "ia-bill-eyebrow-row",
    span(class = "ia-bill-eyebrow", eyebrow_txt)
  ),
  h1(class = "ia-bill-title", display_name),
  div(class = "ia-bill-meta", meta_row)
)
```

```{r}
# Headline figures. Money totals include unitemized and unidentified rows;
# the donor count does not (see donor_attribution in 02_clean_normalize.R).
if (has_contributions) {
  cs <- comm_stats[1, ]
  spent <- if (has_expenditures) sum(all_expenditures$expenditure_amount, na.rm = TRUE) else NA

  ui_stat_grid(
    ui_stat_card("Total raised", dollar(cs$total_raised),
                 sprintf("%s contributions", comma(cs$n_transactions))),
    ui_stat_card("Unique donors", comma(cs$n_unique_donors),
                 sprintf("%s average gift", dollar(cs$avg_contribution, accuracy = 1))),
    ui_stat_card("Total spent",
                 if (is.na(spent)) "—" else dollar(spent),
                 if (has_expenditures) sprintf("%s expenditures", comma(nrow(all_expenditures)))
                 else "No expenditures filed"),
    ui_stat_card("Most recent activity",
                 format(as.Date(cs$last_contribution), "%b %e, %Y"),
                 sprintf("first %s", format(as.Date(cs$first_contribution), "%b %Y")))
  )
}
```

```{r}
if (nrow(by_donor) > 0) {
  by_type <- by_donor |>
    group_by(donor_type) |>
    summarize(total = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  segs <- setNames(
    round(by_type$total),
    str_to_title(by_type$donor_type)
  )
  cols <- setNames(
    ia_ramp(max(length(segs), 2))[seq_along(segs)],
    names(segs)
  )

  tagList(
    ui_share_bar(segs, cols,
                 empty_message = "No contribution data available.",
                 format_value  = dollar),
    # Only gloss the category if it's actually on the page.
    if ("Committee" %in% names(segs)) {
      div(class = "ia-footnote",
          "Committee transfers are money moved from another registered committee.")
    }
  )
} else {
  div(class = "ia-card-sub", "No contribution data available.")
}
```

## Contributions Over Time

```{r}
if (has_contributions) {
  totals_by_year <- by_year |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarize(total = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(totals_by_year, aes(x = year, y = total)) +
    geom_col(fill = IA_PALETTE$ink_soft, width = 0.7) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = ia_year_breaks(totals_by_year$year)) +
    labs(title = "Contributions received by year", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_ia(13)
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

```{r}
if (has_contributions) {
```

## Top Donors

### Top Individual Donors

```{r}
if (nrow(by_donor) > 0) {
  top_individuals <- by_donor |>
    filter(donor_type == "individual") |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    slice_head(n = 25)

  if (nrow(top_individuals) > 0) {
    gt(top_individuals |> select(donor_display, city, state, total, transactions)) |>
      cols_label(
        donor_display = "Donor", city = "City", state = "State",
        total = "Total Given", transactions = "Transactions"
      ) |>
      fmt_currency(columns = total, currency = "USD") |>
      fmt_integer(columns = transactions) |>
      gt_theme_ia()
  } else {
    cat("No individual contribution data found.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

## Donor Geography

### Iowa vs. Outside Iowa

```{r}
if (nrow(by_donor) > 0) {
  grand_total <- sum(by_donor$total, na.rm = TRUE)

  ia_summary <- by_donor |>
    mutate(region = if_else(state == "IA", "Iowa", "Outside Iowa")) |>
    group_by(region) |>
    summarize(
      total        = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE),
      donors       = n(),
      .groups      = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    mutate(pct = total / grand_total)

  gt(ia_summary) |>
    cols_label(
      region       = "",
      total        = "Total Given",
      pct          = "Share",
      transactions = "Transactions",
      donors       = "Unique Donors"
    ) |>
    fmt_currency(columns = total, currency = "USD") |>
    fmt_percent(columns = pct, decimals = 1) |>
    fmt_integer(columns = c(transactions, donors)) |>
    gt_theme_ia()
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

### Iowa Deep Dive

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

iowa_cities_agg <- by_donor |>
  filter(state == "IA", !is.na(city), nchar(city) > 0) |>
  group_by(city) |>
  summarize(
    total        = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
    transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE),
    donors       = n(),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(city_upper = str_to_upper(str_trim(city)))

if (nrow(iowa_cities_agg) > 0) {
  ia_counties <- counties(state = "IA", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE)
  ia_places   <- places(state = "IA", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
    mutate(city_upper = str_to_upper(str_trim(NAME))) |>
    st_centroid()

  city_pts <- ia_places |>
    inner_join(iowa_cities_agg, by = "city_upper")

  if (nrow(city_pts) == 0) {
    cat("No Iowa donor cities could be matched to geographic locations.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Aggregate to county level for choropleth
  county_totals <- city_pts |>
    st_join(ia_counties |> select(county = NAME)) |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    group_by(county) |>
    summarize(total = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  county_map <- ia_counties |>
    left_join(county_totals, by = c("NAME" = "county"))

  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = county_map, aes(fill = total), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = city_pts, aes(size = total), color = IA_PALETTE$green, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = IA_PALETTE$bar_track, high = IA_PALETTE$ink_soft,
      na.value = IA_PALETTE$border_soft,
      labels = dollar_format(),
      name = "County total"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      range = c(1, 9), labels = dollar_format(), name = "City total"
    ) +
    labs(title = "Contributions from Iowa donors") +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      text            = element_text(color = IA_PALETTE$ink_soft),
      plot.title      = element_text(color = IA_PALETTE$ink, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
} else {
  cat("No Iowa contribution data available.\n")
}
```

```{r}
max_rows <- 1000L

if (n_total > max_rows)
  cat(sprintf(
```

```{r}
if (nrow(all_contributions) > 0) {
  all_contributions |>
    slice_head(n = max_rows) |>
    mutate(donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type)) |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      date                = "Date",
      donor_display       = "Donor",
      donor_type          = "Type",
      clean_city          = "City",
      norm_state          = "State",
      contribution_amount = "Amount",
      transaction_type    = "Transaction Type"
    ) |>
    fmt_date(columns = date, date_style = "yMMMd") |>
    fmt_currency(columns = contribution_amount, currency = "USD") |>
    gt_theme_ia()
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

## Expenditures

```{r}
if (has_expenditures) {
  exp_by_type <- all_expenditures |>
    group_by(transaction_type) |>
    summarize(
      total = sum(expenditure_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
      count = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total))

  ggplot(exp_by_type, aes(x = reorder(transaction_type, total), y = total)) +
    geom_col(fill = IA_PALETTE$bar_fill) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
    labs(title = "Expenditures by transaction type", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_ia(12)
} else {
  cat("No expenditure data available.\n")
}
```
